name: Salamanca (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Salamanca (a bull and a tree above a bridge on white, and the bars of Aragon within a bordure of crosses).
history: The arms of Salamanca, timbred with the Spanish royal crown open and without diadems, were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 20 June 1996; the municipal flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, red with the arms of Salamanca at the centre.
